title: Skoropadskyi's Coup
desc:
Due to Oleksandr Ohloblyn's unpopular policies and obvious signs of collaboration with the nazis, in particular, aiding and abetting in racial cleansing-the mass extermination of the Jewish population during World War II in Babyn Yar-and his clear dictatorial tendencies, Danylo Skoropadskyi, a descendant of the last hetman of Ukraine, Pavlo Skoropadsky, with the support of the free Cossack troops and the direct assistance of Stus's United Struggle faction, arrested the elected president on suspicion of treason...

Exactly 46 years ago, on the night of April 29-30, 1918, Pavlo Skoropadskyi also staged a coup against an ineffective government to save Ukraine. It is a strange coincidence, but it seems that fate decided to give Ukraine a reliable pillar of support for society - a hetman.

Now only Danylo will decide the next years of an entire nation that has placed its trust in the hetman. Step by step, plan by plan, brick by brick, Ukraine will rise like a phoenix from the ashes of ruin. The UHS will surpass all other political forces in building a new, strong, globally important Ukrainian Hetmanate!

title: Skoropadskyi Strikes Back!
desc:
Dziuba couldn't believe it. The situation had quickly spiraled out of his control. It was all over. He should have foreseen the consequences of starting repressions against the fascists. It was one thing when all failures could be blamed on the controversial Ohloblyn, but it was quite another when it came to a respected general in the army, a hero of the civil war, and Stus's right-hand man.

Taras Bulba-Borovets refused to submit to our repressive policy against despotism in the country, and together with Stus and Danylo Skoropadskyi, they formed a coalition, supported by 80% of our army, and are already demanding in front of the government building on Khreshchatyk in Kyiv that Ivan Dziuba renounce all presidential powers granted to him by the people.

If he agrees to the military's demands, he will face life-long house arrest somewhere in Bila Tserkva, but if he refuses, citing his right to continue performing presidential functions, he will be arrested and imprisoned.So he chose the path of freedom and voluntarily renounced the position of President of the Ukrainian People Republic.

However, when Stus arrived at the parliament to take the oath, Danylo Skoropadskyi appeared with loyal, well-armed units of the "Free Cossacks". He announced to the entire parliament that from now on he would become the Hetman-leader of the new Ukrainian Hetmanate, and anyone who did not agree with this would be immediately thrown out into the street and stripped of all ranks, like useless trash. The first to recognize the new Hetman was General Taras Bulba-Borovets, because he saw in him the energy and salvation that the Ukrainian land had been waiting for so long. Vasyl Stus agreed only on the condition that he be given the status of Prime Minister in the Hetmanate.

title: First Time In First Grade
desc:
It was a special and long-awaited day for Petro, because finally, after the reconstruction of the once prestigious elite school in Kyiv, which had been closed for several years, he could continue his education without hindrance.Thanks to the efforts of the local city administration, with state investment, a massive restoration of schools across the country has begun.

Galina, the boy's mother, packed the necessary school supplies into his backpack and gave him a generous allowance for the week to donate to further repairs and purchases of books, Ukrainian literature, and educational textbooks for the school. In these post-war times, decades of occupation have resulted in significant illiteracy among the local population. Although teachers were selected based on passing an exam demonstrating sufficient knowledge of their subject, especially fluency in the Ukrainian language, there were cases of teachers lacking experience compared to teachers in other European countries.Wishing him all the best, Galina asked her son to study so that his father would always be proud of him.

Due to traffic problems, the boy was late to the bus station and ended up being the last to arrive in class. All the other first-graders were already sitting at their desks, and the homeroom teacher was trying to keep the class quiet and orderly until the last pupil arrived. Carefully opening the door to the sunlit classroom and seeing his homeroom teacher, Oksana Volodymyrivna, the boy apologized for being late and expressed his gratitude that the others had waited for him. Oksana Volodymyrivna invited her last pupil to the center of the classroom and said; 

- "Childrens, this is your 14th and last classmate, Petro. Please treat him with respect, kindness, and honor so that our class becomes the friendliest group in our school!

title: Support for ROA?
desc:
Since we are currently continuing to work closely with reformist nazis, why not use the same approach with other forces that have dealt with them in the past, such as the ROA(Russian Liberation Army)? At present, we do not have sufficient information about these reformers and do not know their motives, which poses the risk that they may deceive us and drive us into even greater dependence from Germania. At the same time, decisive opposition to their intentions will result in us losing the support of the german elite, so what should we do?

In fact, the hetman was not the only one in this position. ROA general Andrey Vlasov is also in similar conditions in the east, the leader of the russian warlord state, located mostly near Samara city, had to deal with germans most part of post-war period. Danylo, no matter how much he hated the bolsheviks, was ready to compromise with Russian collaborators at a time when it was so necessary for the Hetmanate. Although the general already had one foot in the grave, Vlasov sent a reply from his capital in Samara, agreeing to provide all the details of his flirtations over the years with all supporters of nazi ideology in exchange for comprehensive assistance.

The essence of the agreement is the permanent presence of the Hetmanate volunteer corps in case of wars by the ROA for the unification of Russia. As soon as the ROA unifies Russia, the Hetmanate will be able to recall the volunteer contingent back to Ukraine. In return, former Russian collaborators promise to immediately recognize Ukrainian Hetmanate independence and, after unification, to begin fruitful cooperation aimed at developing a non-german economic sphere of influence in Europe, Asia, and other countries. In addition to this, we should consider the benefits for our newly formed armed forces of studying mountain warfare in the Urals, warfare in the swamps and cold tundras of Siberia, and warfare in conditions of lack of infrastructure in the Far East of Russia.

In Danylo's personal opinion, russian wars for unification with the support of one of the most attractive forces for the hetmanist movement, the ROA, will be beneficial in the long term. Although there are fears in the government that after the death of Vlasov, his successor will not want to confront the Nazis and will ultimately refuse to fulfill the agreements after the unification of Russia. Now all that remains is to weigh all the options and make a final decision...

title: Results of the Second Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The new year of our extremely useful program for society continues to develop and exceed our expectations from last year.

The time has come when our Ukrainian individual farmers are able to independently manage their farms and profit from them. Food produced on agricultural land, in villages, and in state cooperatives is sold on the market, and a significant percentage of these transactions goes to the budget. However, the costs of developing agricultural entrepreneurship are not low.

It's also impossible not to notice periodic monthly jumps in inflation, which isn't and won't be stable, so it is necessary to be cautious about investments, possibly limiting them for some time. The problem of increasing ukrainian consumption of grain crops and other foodstuffs is becoming more and more acute. The state's task is to at least maintain parity between food production and consumption, so that it is not necessary to purchase foreign products.

Despite the constant increase in annual consumption demands of the population, our economy continues to grow rapidly. Our ministry has prepared a new action program to combat inflation, but in return we will be forced to reduce state support for agricultural cooperatives."

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

title: Results of the First Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The first year of consumer spending since the start of state subsidies for the ukrainian agricultural sector has passed, and the first results are already visible. According to statistics, we have improved agricultural production methods, increased our grain reserves, and it appears that they have almost covered all of our national needs.

However, the process of eliminating external influence on our domestic food security sector is still far from its logical conclusion. We hope that in a few years we will be able to fully and, most importantly, independently feed our large and ever-growing population, despite the restrictions of the Second Treaty of the Brest-Litowsk Agreement.

There are many other positive aspects of the state program "BreadBasket". The main one is the increase in local GDP in the regions, which contributes to the growth of the economic power and independence of the Hetmanate. In addition, we can highlight the creation of thousands of new jobs, mainly in villages, as well as the prospects for selling our products to our neighbors, and in a few years, to all of Europe and beyond!

However, we are currently facing difficulties in providing all our citizens with basic necessities, such as insufficient supply of products to remote areas, including Crimea, due to logistical problems. We recommend increasing the size of the garrison on the peninsula due to a new wave of "bread protests" by dissatisfied local radical germans over our prioritization of feeding ukrainians first." 

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

desc:
On this ordinary working morning, Albert Speer, Führer of the Greater Germanic Reich, pored over a report sent by his diplomats from Kyiv.
